feeds.title: Remote Sensing
feeds.description: This is the official blog of the Department of Remote Sensing, University of Wurzburg. Explore the work of the Department in research projects in Remote Sensing and its applications to Earth Observation. The Remote Sensing Chair at University of Wurzburg is based on an institutional cooperation with the German Aerospace Center(DLR), specifically with the German Remote Sensing Data Center(DFD).

feeds.title: Remote Sensing Solutions News
feeds.description: Explore more on recent activities and research projects at Remote Sensing Solutions. With 20 years of experience, Remote Sensing Solutions GmbH (RSS) has become one of the leading value-adding companies for earth observation in Germany. We actively develop new algorithms for remote sensing image interpretation, mass data processing, and new information products based on machine learning and AI. We present new research results at conferences and scientific publications.

feeds.title: Hager Environmental & Atmospheric Technologies Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest info about HEAT, EDAR, and Real-world Emissions on our Blog. Hager Environmental & Atmospheric Technologies, LLC (HEAT) was founded in 2009 by an inventor, Dr. J. Stewart Hager. HEAT provides cutting-edge, unparalleled real-world emissions testing services using EDAR remote sensing worldwide. HEAT's mission is to be an environmental remote sensing company that provides solutions resulting in less cost, less hassle, and less pollution.

feeds.title: VITO Remote Sensing Blog
feeds.description: This Blog gives you the exclusive insights into the Remote Sensing industry, the launching of new platforms for the collaboration of data, information on products and services, and more. From distant satellites to buzzing drones, VITO Remote Sensing enables you to use state-of-the-art sensor technology. Starting from your needs, we develop the right sensor and choose the matching instrument to get your project underway.

feeds.title: MDPI » Remote Sensing
feeds.description: Remote Sensing is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal about the science and application of remote sensing technology, and is published semimonthly online by MDPI. A pioneer in scholarly, open access publishing, MDPI has supported academic communities since 1996. Based in Basel, Switzerland, MDPI has the mission to foster open scientific exchange in all forms, across all disciplines.

feeds.title: Grind GIS
feeds.description: Learn about GIS and Remote Sensing Blogs, Articles, Tutorials, and Maps. Get acquainted with different kinds of open source GIS software and see maps. Grind GIS by Pramod Mishra is an online blog and new portal where you will find all information you need regarding Remote Sensing Technology and its applications.

feeds.title: GisCourse.com Blog
feeds.description: Read articles that refer to the latest releases, capabilities, and functionalities of GIS, Remote Sensing, and CAD software. You can find all kinds of news and information about the GIS community. GisCourse.com belongs to the TYC GIS Group, a consulting firm specializing in advising and technical training with GIS Software applications. Our multidisciplinary team with extensive experience allows us to offer the best training in geomatic-related matters.

feeds.title: GISCafe » Remote Sensing
feeds.description: In this category of GISCafe Voice, Susan Smith discusses Remote Sensing. She writes on several topics, including but not limited to geospatial, architecture, engineering, and construction. GISCafe is a portal offering GIS and geospatial professionals complete GIS product catalog listings, technical papers, GIS news, CEO interviews, multimedia presentations, priority press releases, event postings, job placement and more.

feeds.title: Remote Sensing & GISWRSG
feeds.description: This is our Remote Sensing and GIS blog. This page has full knowledgeable information related to remote sensing (RS), GIS, GPS (GPRS), and Photogrammetry for all students. Read and Learn about GIS, RS, Earth Science, technology, geology, GPS and Current, Articles, Mapping, and more.

feeds.title: EOSDA Blog » Remote Sensing
feeds.description: Follow the Earth Observation System Data Analytics Blog to learn how to use high-resolution images in diverse fields and how to get high-quality data from the world's leading providers in Land Viewer. EOS Data Analytics uniquely combines data from Space and Earth and helps decision-making in all major industries on the planet. Some of their services include Precision Agriculture, Forest Monitoring via Satellite and more.

feeds.title: Benny Istanto Blog » Remote Sensing
feeds.description: In this category of my Blog I write articles on using Remote Sensing to analyze Climate Change and Weather Forecasting. My name is Benny Istanto. I work as a Climate Geographer at Geospatial Operation Support Team (GOST), under Development Economic Data Group (DECDG) in The World Bank. I love GIS, Remote Sensing, and computer programming.

feeds.title: Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation Blog
feeds.description: Read more to learn about how Remote Sensing Technology is applied to monitor and conserve ecology. Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation is a fully open access journal from Wiley and the Zoological Society of London. The journal provides a forum for the rapid publication of peer-reviewed, multidisciplinary research from the interface between remote sensing science and ecology and conservation.

feeds.title: GIS Sensing
feeds.description: Learn about the applications of GIS and Remote sensing in various fields ranging from bio-diversity to Disaster Management. GIS Sensing also posts guides and informative articles on the cutting-edge research going on in Remote Sensing and related fields.

feeds.title: Meteorological Technology International » Remote Sensing
feeds.description: In this category of Meteorological Technology International, you will find updates about climate, weather, forecasting, and measurement with respect to remote sensing. Meteorological Technology International is the world's first and only publication that is dedicated to the latest developments in climate, weather, and hydrometeorological forecasting, measurement and analysis technologies, and service provision.
